concern_summary: This concern encompasses the management and behavior of popups, including their visibility, display, and user interactions when attempting to delete messages, ensuring a seamless user experience during message deletion actions.
This concern includes functionalities that manage the visibility and behavior of popups, enabling user interaction through popup menus and context menus while handling user permissions and actions.

This concern encompasses the functionalities related to determining and managing the deletion state of messages and reports, including navigation and user access when a report or message has been deleted.
This concern relates to the delete action and feedback mechanisms that occur after a message or task is marked for deletion, providing user notifications and state updates.

The concern encompasses all functionalities related to the confirmation process for deleting saved searches, including displaying a confirmation modal and handling user interactions regarding the deletion decision.
This concern centers on extracting and processing action messages that transmit financial information related to reports, ensuring the correct representation for user notifications.
This concern is focused on generating messages related to the deletion of members from a policy change log, capturing the details of the member and their role.
This concern focuses on ensuring web accessibility features are implemented properly to enhance user experience for individuals with disabilities.
Functionalities that process, display, and manage messages linked to account status, particularly regarding success and failure notifications when unlinking login forms and clearing messages.
